name: Private Garden 2
original_name: プライベートガーデン2
source: A puzzle game, focused on sliding tiles around. Basic gameplay involves placing tiles featuring girls together, then moving a "male" tile in to make them disappear. Later mechanics include ice floors, collapsing floors, and so on. After every few puzzles there's a short scene, eventually leading to H.
translation: 一款以滑动方块为核心的益智游戏。基本玩法是将描绘女孩的方块移到一起，然后移动一个“男性”方块使其消失。后续机制包括冰面地板、塌陷地板等。每完成几道谜题后会出现一段短剧情，最终会进入H场景。
